name: 6.9" Flat Round Head Plastic Stirrer
description: Mix things up at your next cocktail reception or gala event with these muddlers and stir sticks. These 6.9" plastic stirrers have a 1" round head that are perfect for visibility and stirring up ingredients and each has a ball end design. Choose from a wide range of colors, and add your organizational or company logo, emblem or message to create a bold branded item. This popular stir stick is a favorite for advertising your business or event, venues, restaurants, casinos, bars, cafes, coffee shops, banquet halls, and hotels.
